name: Texas 42

Country/Region of Origin: USA (Texas)
Time Period: 1887
Historical Development: Invented in Trapp Spring (now Garner), Parker County, Texas, by William Thomas (12) and Walter Earl (14) as a domino alternative to card games; spread across Texas via families and communities; soldiers took it overseas in WWII.
Cultural Significance: Designated State Domino Game of Texas (2011); played in homes, churches, clubs, and tournaments.
4 players in fixed partnerships; players sit opposite their partner.
Double-six set of dominoes (28 tiles, one for each pair from 0 to 6).
Double-six domino set; score sheet or marks (e.g. drawn to form ALL).
Dealer shuffles face down; each player takes 7 dominoes (opponents first, then partner, then dealer). Deal rotates clockwise.

items.text: No Trump (Follow Me): High bidder may play without trumps; doubles high or doubles low.
Doubles trump: Bidder can choose doubles as trumps; doubles form a separate suit ranking 6-6 to 0-0.
Nello: Contract to lose every trick; declarer's partner sits out; no trumps; doubles form own suit.
Plunge: Declarer must have 4+ doubles; partner names trump and declarer leads; must take all 7 tricks. Bid 4+ marks.
Sevens: Each player plays tile with pip total closest to 7; declarer's team must take all 7 tricks.
